whichFiveMinutes.choice: The OPENING SEQUENCE (F11 SC01→SC07, compressed) as a self-contained ~5-minute prototype.
whichFiveMinutes.rationale: The opening is the highest-leverage proof: it must contain the hook, the world, the distinctive environmental action, the protagonist's signature + flaw, natural comedy, an emotional seed, the mystery premise, and a deliberate cliffhanger — exactly what a prototype must demonstrate. It also reuses the most approved assets (Astrid/Olaf refs) and needs only ONE new critical reference (Björn).
whichFiveMinutes.selfContained: Plays as a complete short: beginning (storm) → escalation (crossing/new world) → meaningful action (first tide, muscle+mind) → comedy (Björn×crew) → emotional stake (Olaf failing, Björn's dread) → mystery (two suns, wrong tide) → deliberate cliffhanger (Seth-Nakht claims them).
